'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Ethnic violence in South Sudan]]
**The [[South Sudan]]ese [[South Sudan People's Defence Forces|army]] orders all civilians, [[United Nations Mission in South Sudan|United Nations]] personnel, and [[Foreign aid to Sudan|aid]] workers in the [[Akobo County|Akobo]], [[Nyirol County|Nyirol]], and [[Uror County|Uror]] counties of the [[Jonglei State]] to evacuate ahead of an imminent operation against [[Sudan People's Liberation Movement-in-Opposition|opposition forces]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/south-sudan-orders-un-personnel-civilians-leave-parts-jonglei-state-2026-01-26/ (Reuters)]
*[[Gaza war]]
**Three [[Palestinians]] are killed by [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli forces]] in two separate incidents in the [[Gaza Strip]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israeli-fire-kills-two-people-gaza-us-pressures-both-sides-advance-gaza-deal-2026-01-25/ (Reuters)]
*[[Ituri conflict]]
**The [[Allied Democratic Forces]] kill at least 25 people in several communities in [[Ituri Province]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. [https://www.newvision.co.ug/category/world/25-farmers-killed-by-adf-rebels-in-dr-congo-a-NV_226934 (AFP via ''New Vision'')]
*[[2026 Salamanca shooting]]
**Eleven people are killed and 12 others are injured in a [[mass shooting]] at a [[Association football|football]] match in [[Salamanca, Guanajuato|Salamanca]], [[Guanajuato]], [[Mexico]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cp80419gggro (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[January 2026 North American winter storm]]
**Over a million people are left [[power outage|without power]] across the [[Southern United States|southern]] [[United States]] and at least 10,000 flights cancelled due to the [[winter storm]]. [https://apnews.com/article/winter-storm-snow-ice-power-outages-7ea143995026e68db42ed1b4aec396cb (AP)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/1/25/us-storm-causes-widespread-power-outages-thousands-of-flights-cancelled (Al Jazeera)]
**Seven occupants are killed and another is injured when a [[Bombardier Challenger 650]] jet crashes at [[Bangor International Airport]] in [[Maine]], United States, during [[severe weather]] conditions. [https://www.reuters.com/world/7-dead-1-seriously-injured-plane-crash-maine-airport-cnn-reports-2026-01-26/ (Reuters)]
*The death toll from the recent landslide in [[West Java]], [[Indonesia]], increases to 25 with 72 people still missing and believed to be buried under tonnes of mud, rocks and uprooted trees. [https://news.sky.com/story/dozens-still-missing-after-landslide-on-indonesias-java-island-kills-at-least-25-people-13498297 (Sky News)] [https://apnews.com/article/indonesia-west-java-landslide-d453d653fdd6f05ab7ebe85979c2a61b (AP)]
*A [[merchant ship]] rescues one [[African immigration to Europe|migrant]] in the [[Mediterranean Sea]] after a boat departing from [[Tunisia]] sinks, while authorities report that about 50 others are missing and presumed dead and transfer the survivor to [[Malta]] for medical treatment. [https://www.reuters.com/sustainability/society-equity/one-rescued-50-feared-drowned-after-migrant-boat-sinks-off-tunisia-2026-01-25/ (Reuters)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[Thailand]] launches its first effort to [[Species reintroduction|reintroduce]] [[Endangered species|endangered]] [[Indo-Pacific]] [[Stegostoma tigrinum|leopard shark]]s into the wild by releasing [[Captive breeding|captive-bred]] juveniles near the [[Phuket province]]. [https://www.reuters.com/sustainability/climate-energy/thailand-releases-endangered-leopard-sharks-conservation-push-2026-01-26/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Brazil–Mexico relations]], [[Mexico–Peru relations]]
**[[Brazil]] assumes responsibility for representing [[Mexico]]'s diplomatic interests in [[Peru]], including safeguarding the [[List of diplomatic missions of Mexico|Mexican embassy]] in [[Lima]], after Peru [[International incident|severed relations]] with Mexico following the granting of [[Asylum seeker|asylum]] to former [[Prime Minister of Peru|prime minister]] [[Betssy Chávez]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/brazil-takes-mexicos-diplomatic-representation-peru-after-spat-over-ex-pm-asylum-2026-01-25/ (Reuters)]

**[[France|French]] authorities place the [[Indian people|Indian]] captain of an [[Russian shadow fleet|oil tanker]] intercepted by the [[French Navy]] in the Mediterranean Sea under questioning on suspicion of [[Russian shadow fleet|breaching sanctions]] on [[Petroleum industry in Russia|Russian oil]] shipments, while prosecutors open a preliminary inquiry after the vessel arrives at anchorage near [[Marseille]] and its crew remains aboard.
